record.note: the null campaign: 200 edgeless proposals on the synthetic training split. Budget of 200 chosen because at far=0.001 it predicts on the order of 0.2 per-trial acceptances, which is the smallest budget where 'expect about zero' is a checkable prediction rather than a truism, and because the uncorrected best-of-200 is clearly inflated at that size.
record.stopping_rule: fixed budget; no early stop on any observed result
